Adept at merging process engineering with Generative AI and intelligent automation to drive cost savings, accelerate strategic reporting, and scale global enterprise operations.

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Amdocs Pune Ltd. | Pune, India Process Excellence Specialist Dec 2023 — Present
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Direct enterprise-wide Process Excellence programs across global client , aligning transformation initiatives with corporate strategic goals. • Govern process improvement frameworks and project management compliance across the SDLC for six global regions. • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate operational bottlenecks and deploy Lean Six Sigma and Agile methodologies. • Spearhead the organization-wide "Process Book" initiative to map end-to-end processes, driving global operations standardization. • Innovatively integrated Al-powered tools such as Ask Lisa, Ops GPT, Aqua, and Ottoma into SDLC processes to elevate quality, accelerate delivery and boost productivity.
Integrate Generative AI (Cursor AI and Microsoft 365 Copilot) to build automated workflows, accelerating data-driven insights and operational
tracking.
Developed Process Excellence governance frameworks, documentation, and communication assets to drive enterprise-wide transformation. • Delivered capability-building workshops and presented AI-enabled transformation roadmaps, process improvements, and operational dashboards to senior leadership.
KEY INITIATIVES & ACHIEVEMENTS Enterprise QoO (Quality of Operation) Transformation: AI-enabled platform across ~70 global accounts replacing fragmented reporting — reduced reporting effort by 80%, unlocking 30MM annual efficiency gain. Cycle Time Reduction (Telefonica): Optimized CR testing AHT by 26% (Design Phase) & 15% (Execution), enabling 1.6 additional CRs/month, saving 1 FTE/year. Defect & Backlog Optimization: Reduced incident count from 41% to 29%, backlog from 126 to 30, generating annual savings equivalent to 2 FTEs/year. SLA Enhancement (Vodafone Italy): Minimized Incident Reassignment Rate from 25% to 15% through targeted process interventions.
State Street Corp. Ltd. | Mumbai, India Assistant Manager – Business Process Management Jan 2023 — Dec 2023
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Utilized ARIS to map global AS-IS business processes across Trade Settlement, Corporate Actions, Reconciliation, and Fund Accounting. • Facilitated process-mapping workshops with global SMEs to design optimized, risk-mitigated TO-BE workflows. • Identified process gaps and operational risks; integrated robust internal controls into ARCHER X for systemic compliance tracking. • Governed the global ARIS release cycle and Change Control Hub activities, maintaining 100% operational uptime and ensuring zero business disruption across live financial workflows.
Introduced structural improvements through standardization and automation opportunities, reducing manual operational effort.
Accionlabs Pvt. Ltd. | Pune, India Senior Consultant – Process Improvement Feb 2022 — Dec 2022
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Defined and optimized business process methods, operational parameters, and procedures using core BPM methodologies. • Led process improvement projects spanning Change Management, M&A integrations, and Release Management for Rackspace. • Designed comprehensive risk control plans and operational flowcharts that streamlined post-M&A integration for Rackspace, supporting faster transition to standardized operating processes.
Evaluated current-state workflows and conducted process maturity assessments to identify high-value automation opportunities.
WIKA Group | Pune, India Lean Six Sigma Consultant Jul 2018 — Feb 2022
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Aligned process improvement initiatives with corporate strategic targets using Lean/Six Sigma across production lines and support functions. • Deployed VSM, Business Process Mapping, and statistical data analysis to systematically remove system waste. • Built internal Continuous Improvement capability by designing Lean Six Sigma learning curriculum and training materials and delivering 800+ man-hours of virtual Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt, Green Belt & Yellow Belt) training programs to 50+ global practitioners.
Planned and facilitated Lean Six Sigma capability-building initiatives including training nominations, learning sessions, mentoring,
assessments and certification support for global teams.
Mentored Green Belt candidates on Lean Six Sigma improvement projects, statistical tools, DMAIC methodology and project execution to
drive successful business outcomes.
KEY INITIATIVES & ACHIEVEMENTS
Six Sigma Black Belt Project: Elevated ETM line On-Time Production from 75% to 92% and On-Time Report as finished from 46.4% to 92%.
Value Stream Optimization: Performed 8 VSM assessments across key product groups, achieving 30% reduction in end-to-end lead time.
COPQ Reduction: Minimized Cost of Poor Quality by 75% through a targeted Green Belt project.
Kaizen Governance: Facilitated 40+ Kaizen and Continuous Improvement workshops across global teams, promoting a culture of operational excellence, employee engagement and sustainable process improvement.
Created and standardized Lean Six Sigma templates, training content, process improvement toolkits and best-practice documentation for
enterprise-wide adoption.
Developed Lean Six Sigma training content, facilitator guides, participant handbooks and learning material to support enterprise-wide
capability development programs.
Sidel India Ltd. | Pune, India Industrial Engineer May 2017 — Jun 2018
ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Implemented standardized Lean and Kaizen methodologies across factory floors to enhance production and maximize throughput. • Applied method studies, time studies, and 5S frameworks to eliminate material transit waste and optimize operator movements. • Led layout engineering and end-to-end setup of a new production line utilizing visual factory techniques and lean layouts.
